findings.finding: CreateGlobalTable rejected a valid empty ACTIVE PAY_PER_REQUEST pair with identical key/GSI schemas and NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES streams with ValidationException stating version 2017.11.29 is not supported. DescribeTable remained ordinary regional tables; no legacy behavior is inferred.

CreateGlobalTable authorization requires the global-table ARN and every requested regional table ARN before unsupported-version admission. Global-only, regional-only, and explicit global/source/peer-denied session policies yield AccessDeniedException; complete scoped allow reaches the native unsupported-version ValidationException.

For UpdateGlobalTable(Create us-east-2) against this nonexistent legacy group, AWS checks the global ARN and the requested peer table ARN.
